scope: Three source root causes: navigation render identity, button leading-icon identity, and server Google Form HTTP handling. Generated artifacts, unused fetch helpers, and concurrent search-palette work left alone.

rootCauses.name: Navigation-list render identity
rootCauses.impact: Parent updates remounted navigation children and headings. Tests reproduced lost input DOM identity; stable identity now preserves input values and focus, plus accordion open state. Actual production user-data loss was not observed.
rootCauses.fix: Hoist HeadlineHeader and ChildrenRender to module scope and pass content as props. Preserve responsive collapse conditions, styling, child keys, and headline defaults.
rootCauses.tests: Two before-failing regressions pass for plain and collapsed layouts, checking DOM identity, input value/focus, updated heading text and expanded state.

rootCauses.name: Button leading-icon render identity
rootCauses.impact: Lower-severity visual reliability issue: parent updates unnecessarily remounted the leading icon/avatar. The real icon uses visibility/loading state, so remounting can restart that state. DOM replacement was reproduced; no production flicker measurement is claimed.
rootCauses.fix: Hoist StartIcon and pass content explicitly. Preserve the component slot even when empty, image/icon precedence, size choices and click behavior.
rootCauses.tests: Before-failing raised/FAB icon-identity tests now pass and assert an icon is actually present. Existing CMS action/callback test passes.

rootCauses.name: Google Form HTTP status handling
rootCauses.impact: HTTP failures were parsed as successful form downloads, causing misleading parser errors or accepting a form-shaped error response. This matters when Google denies access, rate-limits requests, or is unavailable.
rootCauses.fix: Reject non-OK responses before reading their body, with a status-only error that does not expose the request URL. Keep successful parsing and googleFormGetData error logging/null fallback unchanged.
rootCauses.tests: 403/404/429/500 form-shaped responses reproduced the bug before the fix. All now reject before body consumption and retain null fallback. Existing successful label, field, choice and date parsing tests pass.

recipeReview: Fetched all three recipes using curl with Cache-Control:no-cache and Pragma:no-cache. Source review and failing runtime tests establish real defects. Module-scope components with explicit props and response.ok before consuming text follow canonical fixes. No suppressions.
grouping: Selected diagnostics have no fixGroupId. Duplicate nesting rules grouped with their underlying component identity. Both navigation helpers share the navigation-list render-identity repair.
